name: technology-evaluation-matrix
description: Evaluate technology options (frameworks, databases, languages, SaaS tools, libraries) using a weighted scoring matrix. Criteria: fit for requirement, maturity, community + ecosystem, cost (licensing + operational + TCO), learning curve, integration, licensing compatibility, vendor risk, performance characteristics, security posture. Per option: score + rationale per criterion. Recommendation with trade-offs and reversal conditions. Distinct from build-vs-buy (which compares build / buy / non-consumption); this picks between comparable options. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
